approval_case.title: Ask Hao for the one spending decision that remains
approval_case.situation: The owner finished diagnosis and internal proof. Final compatibility proof needs one $180 vendor run, and no standing budget covers it.
approval_case.hao_request: The producer vaguely asks what to do about compatibility.
approval_case.correct_behavior: Deliver one precise decision packet: approve or reject the one-time $180 vendor run against the named test artifact. Recommend approval because it is the remaining release proof. State that approval starts the run and May will verify the vendor report; rejection keeps the release blocked and records that compatibility is unproven. Do not send the finished technical diagnosis back to the owner.
